text: My experience here was great! The dermatologist spoke brilliant English and she diagnosed me for my skin problem. I was seen to straight away, the whole process was pleasant and quick! I can totally recommend this place.
The service was excellent. Everything was explained clearly, and the treatment cost wasn't expensive either.

I received treatment, applied cream, and took antihistamine medication for about a week, but my symptoms didn't improve. So I called the clinic back and asked if I could use cold-pressed coconut oil along with the antihistamine cream because my itching worsened when my skin was dry. I was worried that it would worsen the allergy and itching. However, I was met with laughter and ridicule at my question. I would like to request training for staff on etiquette regarding expressing feelings. I don't understand what was so funny about my question. My illness is a form of suffering. Laughing like that shows that the patient's question was nonsensical. The response I received was, "We are not doctors, we cannot answer that. Please come back to see a doctor." I know you are not a doctor, but you should have a way of informing the patient or asking someone who knows, not laughing at the patient. In the end, it seemed like a pharmacist took over the call from the counter staff and gave an answer within the scope of what they were capable of providing.
I want to reiterate!!! I was asking about using other creams or lotions along with the medication I was taking because I was concerned, and hearing laughter and ridicule showed that you treated another person's suffering as trivial.

The ladies here are honest, warm, and caring.  I'm so glad I came here to have my wounds treated here instead of the bigger predatory hospitals here in CM.  Thank you all for being such sweet hearts 🙏 …
The medication was dispensed accurately and at an affordable price. Excellent!
The treatment was spot-on and the medication was perfect. My allergic reaction to foundation cream completely disappeared! Excellent service! 😁❤️ …
Good service, the doctor is so friendly, she gives very good advice and does not try to have us buy any of their medicines, price of mine is 270 (240 for advise and 30 for new member card)

The doctors here are excellent. They give great advice, and the medication is very effective. I had an itchy rash on my legs for many years, but after treatment here, the rash has improved significantly and is now completely itchy. God bless you ❤️

I had acne on my back and have been receiving treatment here for about 5-6 months. I received both oral and topical medication. Now that I've stopped taking the medication, the acne hasn't returned. The medication is a bit expensive, but it's worth it. I've had acne since high school until my twenties, and it really cleared up. I recommend it.

I've been going there since I was in 5th grade, 23 years ago, because I've had acne since I was a child. At that time, I was treated by a Western doctor. Now I take my child there because it's been renovated and modernized. The staff are kind and the doctors are friendly. The clinic is very clean and the prices are not expensive.

Terrible service. I paid 150 baht for their rude behavior. They won't get to treat me next time. The doctor in the adjacent room, who was taking patient histories, had a very poor attitude and demeanor. I paid for this service, not for free treatment. Consider the 150 baht I gave them for food. I will never go here again.
The doctor spoke very politely.

text: The place is clean, specializes in dermatology, the doctor is experienced, and the prices are affordable.
I went there last year. It was cheaper than I expected, and the medicine was very effective. If you follow the doctor's instructions, you'll be cured.

I was treated for oral allergies. My lips were red, inflamed, sore, and dry and scaly. The doctor was thorough; I received injections, oral medication, and topical cream. My symptoms improved within a day. I think I received the right treatment, and it wasn't expensive either.

text: The service was excellent.
The reception staff and the doctor provided excellent service. The cost of medication was reasonable.

Effective and affordable medicine. It's the same medicine they said was incurable, but after using this medicine, my condition improved by 90%. No more scratching or picking at the sores. Good service and clean place.

I needed to buy medicated powder and soap for my bedridden son. He has a problem with his groin area because he often lies on it, preventing proper exposure to moisture. He needs the medicated powder and soap constantly. This is an alternative clinic with moderate prices – not too expensive, but they don't accept severe cases. They focus on treating skin diseases as it's a branch of McKean Hospital. I recommend coming here for convenience and faster service because patients come in gradually. You won't be disappointed.
The ointment is very good after use.

I had psoriasis that went away but has returned. I'm going to see a doctor on Saturday morning. I want to know the cost of treatment. A friend recommended this doctor and nurse; the doctor is very kind and said I'll see results immediately.

Excellent service! I've had varicose veins for six years, and they've never fully healed. I went to see the doctor last week and received antihistamines, anti-itch medication, antibiotics, soap, and cream. I used them for six days, and the itchiness went away from the first day I took the medication. The scars have faded significantly. (Dr. Smith told me the varicose veins aren't related to bad lymphatic fluid, but rather to sensitive skin, dirty water, dirty air, and mosquito and insect bites.) And the price wasn't too bad either. The total cost for that day was just 605 baht. 👏👏
The service was excellent! There weren't many patients. Most importantly, I saw results in 3 days, and after 1 week, I'm completely cured.

The doctor did not perform a thorough examination of my skin. I had skin cancer removed last year in the USA. Now something is growing on my skin where the cancer was before. This doctor says it looks OK, but he doesn't look closely at my skin. Never even got out of his chair. Then he said I should see a doctor in USA when I go back. So I ask him, if it's not cancer now, then why should I see doctor in the USA? Then he says something about Donald Trump and laughs. I think he is Australian. Maybe he doesn't like Americans. Fortunately, I was only there about 20 minutes. So not  too much time wasted.

Even though it was a Saturday morning, from the moment I walked into the clinic until I left to pay and receive my medication, all the staff provided service with willingness and attentiveness. I was very impressed with the service at this clinic.

In addition, they have a team of dermatologists.
The doctor was thorough in diagnosing my condition, asking about my history, explaining point by point what my problem was, what medication would be best, and providing knowledge on self-care.

I feel fortunate to have such a good clinic in Chiang Mai.
